messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt blocked for production. tag=release-2026-03-20 commit=a1b2c3d env=prod target=v1.4.2. CI gate failed: artifact-signature step failed (job 4829). Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/4829 :x:

maria: on it, checking CI logs and signing service keys.

samir: is this signature mismatch or checksum? any error snippet?

maria: log extract: [artifact verify] signature verification failed: ERR_SIG_MISMATCH for package redwood-runtime-1.4.2.whl

ajay: hmm, did we rotate the signing key? @elaine any infra changes to signing keys?

elaine: no key rotations on my side. releasing team didn't change KEY_ID. tagging @ops for visibility.

nelson: if signing service is flaky we should block prod. canary ok? maybe pin to yesterday's build for canary only.

qa-bot: CI history shows 3 artifact-signature failures on staging in last 24h, all during package publish step.

samir: if we revert to previous artifact we avoid waiting on signing fix. but need to ensure no DB schema mismatch. this is a binary wheel only.

ajay: can we re-run just the signing job? deploy-bot, what is the command to retry job 4829?

deploy-bot: CI retry available: `ci retry job 4829`. current job status: failed -> artifacts not signed. See full log: https://ci.internal/jobs/4829/log

maria: i'll kick a retry after confirming signing service keys.

(20 minutes later)

deploy-bot: CI retry 4829 completed: FAILED again. signature verify failed. link: https://ci.internal/jobs/4829/log#retry1 :frowning:

nelson: ok no more retries. i'll open a revert PR to pin artifact to release-2026-03-19 (hash b8f9e2) for the prod rollout and block the v1.4.2 tag. preparing PR now.

elaine: approve revert PR once ready. we'll hold prod change window and notify SRE and Support. canary stays on hold until revert merges and we validate smoke.

samir: checklist: revert PR, run smoke on staging, confirm no schema drift, then re-open release. add postmortem if signing infra still unstable. :warning:

ajay: adding note — if signing service key is broken we need incident-ops ticket. tagging ops.

deploy-bot: STATUS UPDATE: Canary deploy prevented; overall deploy status=HOLD. Reason: CI gate failed (artifact-signature). Revert PR created: https://scm.internal/p/redwood/repo/pull/1124.

maria: i've filed a quick runbook entry in ops ticket #OPS-921 for signing verification steps.

elaine: good. i'll send a short notification to #customer-updates that the prod release is delayed pending artifact verification.

nelson: PR opened and pinned to b8f9e2, tests queued. once CI green i'll merge and trigger a controlled canary.

deploy-bot: final: last action=PR opened and canary blocked. Keep thread for follow-ups.
